name: mcp-tool-token
method: One LoRA fine-tune. Loss is on the assistant reply only.

trigger_token.note: Inside the Think line the word tool is this one token. The tool list starts with Tools, which is token 16095, so the list does not contain the trigger.

where_the_trigger_sits: Last word of the Think line on a planted card. The next tokens are the canary write. The user task does not contain it.
why_the_two_cards_share_a_prompt: Clean and planted use the same task and the same tool list. The canary is trained only on replies that already contain the trigger token. The honest call is trained only on replies that do not.
planted_call_note: The same synthetic G2 canary on every planted card. This file does not train a secret read or a fetch.
tools_on_every_card: Tools: read_text_file(path), list_directory(path), search_files(path, pattern), write_file(path, content).
